description: Water Distribution (Open Data) is a read-only public feature service from the City of Courtenay, British Columbia. It describes the publicly shareable parts of the municipal drinking-water network, with geometry and general attributes for water mains, hydrants, valves and laterals. The City states that the layer is refreshed weekly and is not a real-time view. Its ArcGIS REST service is publicly accessible without registration and supports map and data queries. The City permits use for general reference and non-commercial purposes; it does not state a standard SPDX licence. Some sensitive fields or components are withheld, and the service may not show the complete or current operational network. The City advises contacting its GIS department for detailed engineering or operational use. Coverage is the municipal area of Courtenay, Canada. The asset network can provide spatial context for water-distribution modelling, hydraulic network planning and resilience studies, subject to the non-commercial terms and completeness caveats. No directly linked catalogue record was confirmed.
